name: Sensei X2
description: The Sensei X2 is a third-generation teleoperated intravascular robotic catheter system developed by [Hansen Medical](/company/hansen_medical) for cardiac electrophysiology mapping and catheter ablation procedures, including atrial fibrillation. Controlled from a radiation-shielded physician workstation via a 3D hand controller (Instinctive Motion) with IntelliSense tactile force-sensing feedback and multi-modality imaging integration, the bedside robotic catheter manipulator (RCM) drives coaxial tendon-driven Artisan and Artisan Extend steerable sheaths with three degrees of freedom (deflection, rotation, and axial translation). Built with an open architecture compatible with third-party diagnostic and mapping catheters—such as Boston Scientific PolarisDx and St. Jude Medical Livewire catheters—as well as standard electro-anatomic mapping systems, the Sensei X2 introduced a slimmer console profile and faster image processing over the earlier Sensei X upon its 2014 clearance and launch. The platform was discontinued following Auris Surgical Robotics' acquisition of Hansen Medical in July 2016.
